scope: Compared v2 protocol and config with v1 and checked all five v1 static-review blockers. Read prior EXP-0025/DYN-0001 source and evidence; no research model execution, training, prototype fitting or new tau generation.

resolved_blockers.resolution: T256/512/1024 are explicitly terminal pre-refresh accuracies from the same complete trajectory. The nine independently qualified new REL seeds are frozen by ID; each R path first reports all nine NONE patterns, then its all-three-HOLD-<.95 conditional failure subset. The text identifies this as selection on exposed main data. ORIGINAL GAUGE failures remain listed and take the CONTROL_INCONCLUSIVE overall branch if no gated window remains.

The ordered six-k success vectors now include a proper contiguous suffix ending at K64 as SUFFIX_WINDOW_RIGHT_CENSORED, counted in the primary one-or-more-window branch. Empty, full, proper prefix, bounded middle, proper suffix and noncontiguous patterns have distinct labels. The overall verdict uses the exact full category strings.
PHASE16 and PHASE32 now explicitly use the frozen EQUAL8 operator; only the timing phase differs from K16 and K32.

COUNT90's n_i is the full-T1024 ADAPT90 attempt count for the identical seed, arm, cell, example and ORIGINAL path, including failed attempts and t1024. COUNT uses EQUAL8 on its precomputed integer schedule even after its own trajectory diverges. ADAPT tests pre-refresh distance, charges invalid attempts to cooldown, and preserves n_i=0 as no operation. Both event-time lists, validity and reasons are retained. The future-count control remains explicitly retrospective.

The supplemental raw schema retains each rollout's per-example/per-time pre logits and prototype distances, input hashes and threshold, indexed event validity/reason and pre/post geometry, full NONE Gram trajectories, tau distance curves and censor flags, ADAPT/COUNT event lists, and exact terminal correct counts over 512. The protocol says aggregate curves cannot replace full raw. Command-response snapshots and weighted Frobenius coordinates with an explicit readout-kernel projection and unavailable conditions are frozen.

Verify frozen calibration q90 from 512x8 predicted-class pre-refresh Gram distances with weighted off-diagonal sqrt(2), no test target access; test ADAPT cooldown after invalid attempts, COUNT same-example count pairing and retrospective schedule, tau right censor at 256 versus 257 censored examples, and source/hash binding.

interpretation_limits: Approval is for implementing the registered v2 matrix and its engineering validation. Any result remains conditional on previously exposed models and on a main-data NONE-selected failure subset; GAUGE-gated schedule windows do not isolate organisation or a slow mode.
